dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I want to file a complaint! I want to expose the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency as failing to live up to its reputation and bullying their customers!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Three months ago, I entrusted them with sending a letter, a confession filled with my love... but I still haven't received a reply!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The guards must have been negligent and lost my letter!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The letter you commissioned us to deliver was delivered as requested some time ago. Please accept the reality of the situation."
